popCulture.title: Cephissus (mythology)
popCulture.description: River-god of Attica and Boeotia — father of Narcissus in Ovid, and a water-power in Attic genealogies and cult.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid makes the river Cephisus Narcissus' father — the Boeotian stream that begets the boy who will love his own reflection.
